== 说明 ==
要使用此模板，请添加{{T|{{BASEPAGENAME}}}}模板并填写对应字段。留空的字段不会在文章中显示。此信息框模板采用[[w:Help:Infobox|Fandom的信息框语法]]。

== 语法 ==
<pre>
{{Series
 | title     = 
 | image     = 
 | caption   = 
 | release   = 
 | seasons   = 
 | episodes  = 
 | runtime   = 
 | genre     = 
 | network   = 
 | distrib   = 
 | creator   = 
 | writer    = 
 | director  = 
 | composer  = 
 | based on  = 
 | exec prod = 
 | producer  = 
 | prod co   = 
 | country   = 
 | language  = 
}}</pre>
